name: add-checks-price-before-quantity
why: validates the price before the quantity.

edits.old: if (w.size() != 4 || !parse_int(w[2], qty) || !parse_price(w[3], price)) return reject("usage: add <name> <qty> <price>");
edits.new:
if (w.size() != 4 || !parse_int(w[2], qty) || !parse_price(w[3], price)) return reject("usage: add <name> <qty> <price>");
        if (price < 0) return reject("price must not be negative");

edits.old:
if (qty <= 0) return reject("quantity must be a positive integer");
        if (price < 0) return reject("price must not be negative");
edits.new: if (qty <= 0) return reject("quantity must be a positive integer");

name: add-extra-arguments-ignored
why: accepts extra words after the price.

edits.old: if (w.size() != 4 || !parse_int(w[2], qty) || !parse_price(w[3], price)) return reject("usage: add <name> <qty> <price>");
edits.new: if (w.size() < 4 || !parse_int(w[2], qty) || !parse_price(w[3], price)) return reject("usage: add <name> <qty> <price>");

name: add-keeps-old-price
why: does not update the price of an existing item.

edits.old: item->price = price;

name: add-negative-zero-printed
why: does not normalize -0, so it prints as -0.00.

edits.old: if (price == 0) price = 0.0;  // "-0" parses as negative zero, which would print as "-0.00"

name: add-overflow-check-off-by-one
why: rejects a total of exactly INT_MAX.

edits.old: if (item->quantity > INT_MAX - qty) return reject("quantity too large");
edits.new: if (item->quantity >= INT_MAX - qty) return reject("quantity too large");

name: add-overflow-unchecked
why: adds without checking for int overflow.

edits.old: if (item->quantity > INT_MAX - qty) return reject("quantity too large");

name: add-replaces-quantity
why: sets the quantity instead of adding to it.

edits.old: item->quantity += qty;

name: blank-line-is-an-error
why: reports an error for blank lines.

edits.old: if (words.empty()) continue;  // blank line

name: find-matches-prefixes
why: treats an item whose name is a prefix of the requested name as the same item.

edits.old: const auto it = std::find_if(items.begin(), items.end(), [&](const Item& i) { return i.name == name; });
edits.new: const auto it = std::find_if(items.begin(), items.end(), [&](const Item& i) { return name.rfind(i.name, 0) == 0; });

name: leaks-memory
why: allocates with new[] and never frees (fails the Clean tier).

edits.old: std::vector<Item> items;

name: money-not-fixed
why: formats without std::fixed, so 8.5 prints as 8.5.

edits.old: os << std::fixed << std::setprecision(2) << value;

name: nan-price-accepted
why: does not reject nan and inf.

edits.old: return ec == std::errc() && ptr == end && std::isfinite(out);

name: price-accepts-negative
why: does not reject a negative price in the price command.

edits.old:
if (w.size() != 3 || !parse_price(w[2], price)) return reject("usage: price <name> <price>");
        if (price < 0) return reject("price must not be negative");

name: price-trailing-junk-accepted
why: does not check that the whole word was a number (2.5abc is 2.5).

edits.old: return ec == std::errc() && ptr == end && std::isfinite(out);

name: quantity-trailing-junk-accepted
why: does not check that the whole word was a number (12x is 12).

edits.old: return ec == std::errc() && ptr == end;

name: quit-does-not-stop
why: keeps processing after quit.

edits.old: return true;

name: remove-ignores-stock
why: lets the quantity go negative.

edits.old: if (item->quantity < qty) return reject("not enough " + w[1] + " (have " + std::to_string(item->quantity) + ")");

name: remove-reads-after-erase
why: reads the quantity after erasing the element (stale or shifted data).

edits.old: item->quantity -= qty;
if (left == 0) items.erase(items.begin() + (item - items.data()));  // erase AFTER reading what we need

name: remove-zero-keeps-item
why: never erases an item that reaches zero.

edits.old: if (left == 0) items.erase(items.begin() + (item - items.data()));  // erase AFTER reading what we need

name: report-empty-is-silent

edits.old: std::cout << "inventory is empty\n";

name: report-no-total

name: report-unsorted
why: lists items in insertion order.

name: unknown-command-silent
